runs.content: US markets closed for Thanksgiving, so no trade was entered; price-update-only run with no stop/T1/T2/signal triggers, AUTO and BATS repriced to LSE closes, Net P&L +$1,474 (+1.47%), €1,743 cap headroom.
Staples lead the quarter and BAT trades at ~11.8x forward earnings with a ~5.6% yield and a running £1.3bn buyback, 8% below its 52-week high (prices in GBX; ITX trimmed for capacity).
